# dybatpho

> A Bash 4.3+ library of `dybatpho::*` functions for writing robust shell
> scripts: strict mode, logging, CLI parsing from a declared spec, cleanup
> traps, temporary files, retries, JSON, networking and more, split into
> modules a script loads on demand.

- Source `init.sh` once, naming the modules the script needs:
  `. dybatpho/init.sh --modules cli network`. Without `--modules` only the
  core modules load: string, os, logging, helpers, process, file, secret, array.
- Every public function is named `dybatpho::<name>`; a name starting with
  `__dybatpho_` is internal. Before writing a helper by hand, look for an
  existing function in [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).
- An experimental module may change in any minor release; the others keep
  their contract across minor releases.
- Links are relative to the repository root, so they resolve in a checkout and
  under https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dynamotn/dybatpho/main/.
- Generated by `scripts/docs.sh` from the source comments;
  `scripts/docs.sh --check` fails when it is stale.

## Modules

- [init](docs/init.md): Initial script
- [agent](docs/agent.md): Utilities for making a script usable by an AI agent (experimental)
- [ai](docs/ai.md): Utilities for calling large language models from shell scripts (experimental)
- [archive](docs/archive.md): Utilities for creating, extracting, and listing archives
- [array](docs/array.md): Utilities for working with array
- [backup](docs/backup.md): Utilities for taking backups and applying a retention policy (experimental)
- [cache](docs/cache.md): Utilities for remembering an answer on disk until it goes stale (experimental)
- [cli](docs/cli.md): Utilities for building CLI parsers from shell specs.
- [config](docs/config.md): Utilities for loading configuration from files and environment variables.
- [csv](docs/csv.md): Utilities for reading, filtering and writing CSV data (experimental)
- [date](docs/date.md): Utilities for working with dates and timestamps
- [db](docs/db.md): Utilities for keeping a script's state in SQLite (experimental)
- [diff](docs/diff.md): Utilities for comparing text and structured documents (experimental)
- [doctor](docs/doctor.md): Utilities for checking that the environment can run what a script loaded (experimental)
- [file](docs/file.md): Utilities for file handling
- [forge](docs/forge.md): Utilities for talking to the forge a repository is hosted on (experimental)
- [git](docs/git.md): Utilities for Git repositories
- [helpers](docs/helpers.md): Utilities for common shell-script helper patterns.
- [i18n](docs/i18n.md): Utilities for translating messages and formatting values for a locale (experimental)
- [json](docs/json.md): Utilities for working with JSON and YAML data
- [lock](docs/lock.md): Utilities for process locking and coordination
- [logging](docs/logging.md): Utilities for logging to stdout/stderr
- [markdown](docs/markdown.md): Utilities for building structured Markdown content (experimental)
- [math](docs/math.md): Exact decimal arithmetic, comparison, rounding and aggregation
- [metrics](docs/metrics.md): Utilities for measuring a script and exporting the result to Prometheus (experimental)
- [network](docs/network.md): Utilities for network
- [notification](docs/notification.md): Utilities for sending messages to chat and notification providers (experimental)
- [os](docs/os.md): Utilities for getting information of OS/distro
- [parallel](docs/parallel.md): Utilities for running work concurrently with a bounded worker pool (experimental)
- [pkg](docs/pkg.md): Package manager detection and guarded dependency installation (experimental)
- [privilege](docs/privilege.md): Acquiring and holding a privilege escalation for a run (experimental)
- [process](docs/process.md): Utilities for process handling
- [profile](docs/profile.md): Utilities for finding where a Bash script spends its time (experimental)
- [queue](docs/queue.md): A durable job queue backed by the filesystem (experimental)
- [release](docs/release.md): Utilities for cutting a release from a Git repository (experimental)
- [safety](docs/safety.md): Guards for destructive operations
- [schedule](docs/schedule.md): Deciding when a command should run, and running it on a cadence (experimental)
- [screen](docs/screen.md): Full-screen terminal applications: layout, widgets, and an event loop (experimental)
- [secret](docs/secret.md): Utilities for handling secrets safely
- [semver](docs/semver.md): Utilities for working with Semantic Versioning (semver)
- [service](docs/service.md): Utilities for enabling, controlling and installing services (experimental)
- [sign](docs/sign.md): Utilities for signing files and checking signatures (experimental)
- [string](docs/string.md): Utilities for working with string
- [table](docs/table.md): Utilities for rendering aligned plain-text tables (experimental)
- [testing](docs/testing.md): Extended assertions, snapshots, mocks, and self-cleaning fixtures for shell tests (experimental)
- [text](docs/text.md): Utilities for working with multi-line text blocks (experimental)
- [tui](docs/tui.md): Interactive terminal widgets: spinners, progress bars, menus, and confirmations (experimental)
- [validate](docs/validate.md): One validator for the whole library: named value types and declarative rules

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): Every public function's signature and one-line description, grouped by module
- [Agent Skill](skills/dybatpho/SKILL.md): How an agent writes a script on dybatpho
- [Migration guide](docs/MIGRATING.md): What each major version breaks and how to move a script
- [Specifications](docs/spec/README.md): The behaviour every module promises
